title: Ngā kaihaerere o te mara matomato
intro: I ngā wā onamata, tokorua ngā tāngata e tiaki ana i ngā whenua tata. I honoa ō rāua ara, engari i arahina rāua e ō rāua ngākau ki ngā wāhi tino rerekē. Ko tētahi i haere i te ara tika, ko tētahi i kotiti ke ki te pōuri o te whakakāhore. Ka taea e koe te wetewete i te mea ngaro o ēnei kaitiaki kotinga tokorua?
clues: He nui ngā hua i a au, he momona ngā kotinga i miharo ai ngā kanohi o te hunga e mātakitaki ana.
Nui atu ngā taonga a tōku hoa noho i ahau, heoi i hiahia ahau ki tā rātou wahi nui atu i taku ake.
I mea atu ahau me whakangaro rawa ā rātou hua, kia whakakotahitia ngā mea katoa i raro i taku mana whakahaere.
I kawea mai e ahau te whakangaromanga ki taku ake kotinga, i whakangaromia nga mea katoa i roto i taku mahi wairangi.
I tū kahakore noa iho ahau i te mea e maroke ana aku hua, ā, kua memeha haere aku taonga i te pō kotahi.
Kāore he wāhi mōku i te ao tūroa, ā, ko tōku nohoanga whakamutunga hei poka ahi e mura ana.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ko te tangata i whakakahore i te aranga me te whakawa
Te rangatira i tukino i te kaiahuwhenua tika
Te rangatira whenua whai rawa kāore i te whakawhetai
Te kaiahuwhenua i hiahia ki te whenua o tōna hoa noho
Te hoa tinihanga i whakatakoto i te whakangaromanga
identity.answer: Te kaiahuwhenua i hiahia ki te whenua o tōna hoa noho

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whakamātautau mō te whiwhi i te whakakitenga atua
Te wero o te taonga me te manawanui
Te whakamatautauranga ki te whakangaro i te oranga o te tangata tika
Te whakahau kia wehewehea tika te taonga tuku iho
Te pakanga ki te tukino a te kaitukino
trial.answer: Te whakamatautauranga ki te whakangaro i te oranga o te tangata tika

outcome.label: Hua
options: He pararaiha mutungakore hei utu mō te tika
